subject: Security exhibit — onboarding checklist and pen-test windowing
messages:
From: Clark Evans <clark.evans@clarityhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Kwan <aisha.kwan@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit — initial ask and timing

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal at ClarityHealth is requesting a security exhibit and explicit language around audit rights and penetration testing for the MSA + Order Form. We've attached a short summary of the questions they want answered (see Security_Exhibit_Draft_v1.pdf).

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood confirm a standard pen-test window (how long in advance we need to be notified and the support/access we provide)?
- What evidence cadence can you commit to for SOC 2 artifacts and audit logs during onboarding (monthly/quarterly snapshots, who owns collection)?

We have an internal renewal committee review on 2028-06-20 and would like to have redlines back by 2028-06-12 if possible.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Clark
Director, IS Operations
ClarityHealth

Attachments: Security_Exhibit_Draft_v1.pdf

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Clark Evans <clark.evans@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — initial ask and timing

Clark — thanks for the clear note and the deadline. Looping in our legal lead, Laura, and security/assurance (Priyom) so they can scope answers and suggest contract language.

High level on the two asks so you have a sense before Laura sends redlines:
- Pen-test window: standard practice is 14 calendar days' notice for non-intrusive checks; for full scoped pentests we require a 30-day scheduling window plus an agreed-upon blast-radius/segmented staging environment. We can provide temporary staging creds and 48-hour on-call engineering support during the test.
- Evidence cadence: SOC 2 artifacts (report &attestations) are available on request; for onboarding we typically deliver an evidence bundle (summaries, key control owners, audit logs) once — then quarterly snapshots for 6 months, then on-demand tied to procurement cycles. We can also agree to a shared Drive folder for periodic exports.

Laura/Priyom — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a clause that allows ClarityHealth an inspection right with advance notice (and what the notice period should be in the MSA)? See Clark's requested date for redlines.

Sean
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Cc: Clark Evans <clark.evans@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — initial ask and timing

Sean/Clark — I reviewed the attached draft. A few notes we plan to propose in redlines: 

1) Audit rights: propose language that allows a third-party auditor (mutually agreed, nondisruptive) to perform an assessment once per 12 months with 30 days' written notice; for ad-hoc requests we will provide scoped read-only evidence exports but will not permit live on-prem inspection without an SOW.

2) Pen test: we can accept customer-conducted pen tests against a staging environment under the following conditions:
   - 30 days' scheduling notice for full-scope tests; 7 days for low-risk scans.
   - A mutually agreed blast-radius and a point-of-contact in engineering.
   - Tests that may impact production outages are not permitted without an emergency coordination SOW and SLA credits language.

3) Evidence cadence: offer a quarterly snapshot for the first 90 days of onboarding (t=0, t=30, t=90) including: SOC 2 summary, control owners, sanitized audit logs (redaction of PII), and a one-page findings summary. After that, we will provide on-demand exports with 5 business days' lead time.

I'm attaching a redline-friendly PDF and an XLS with a proposed pen-test schedule template (pen-test-scope-proposed.xlsx). Action items:
- Sean: confirm Clarity's desired notice windows and whether they need live on-site inspection language.
- Clark: please review the three bullets above and flag anything that won't work for your procurement or compliance teams.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Security_Exhibit_Draft_v1-redlines.pdf, pen-test-scope-proposed.xlsx

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Clark Evans <clark.evans@clarityhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — initial ask and timing (technical follow-up)

Clark — quick technical clarifications from our security team:
- Staging access: we can provide a time-limited staging environment with obfuscated customer data; access is via SSO and ephemeral credentials (validity 72 hours).
- Log exports: we can deliver sanitized VPC flow logs and application request traces for the 30-day window as CSV exports. Full raw logs require an auditor NDA and additional redaction steps.
- Pen-test tooling: we accept common scanners (OWASP ZAP, Nessus) and manual testing; we disallow automated mass credential stuffing and noisy flood tools.

We'll attach a short technical appendix to the redline bundle with a sample staging checklist and support contacts.

Priyom Das
Security & Assurance 
Attachments: Proof_of_SOC2_Summary.pdf

1) We can accept the 12-month auditor cadence and 30-day notice for full-scope pen tests.
2) For the procurement committee timeline: we still need a short redline PDF by tomorrow 2028-06-13 COB to make the 06-20 review. Can you confirm you'll be able to deliver a redline-ready PDF (Laura) and the technical appendix (Priyom) by then?

If yes, we'll schedule a 30-minute call Wednesday 06-14 to walk the committee through the exhibit.

Best,
Clark
